title: Airy Citrusy Japanese Pork Belly Bento
description: A refreshing, post-workout Japanese dish featuring tender pork belly slices, crunchy carrots, and a drizzle of citrusy ponzu sauce.
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine soy sauce, sake, sugar, ginger, and garlic. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Place the pork belly on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes, or until tender and slightly caramelized.
Blanch the carrots and green beans in boiling water for 3-4 minutes, or until tender but still crisp. Drain and set aside.
Cut the pork belly into thin slices and place on a separate baking sheet lined with parchment paper.

Drizzle the pork belly slices with ponzu sauce and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Return to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes, or until the sauce is caramelized and the pork is heated through.
To assemble the bento, place a portion of the pork belly slices on a bed of carrots and green beans in a small bowl or container. Drizzle with additional ponzu sauce if desired.
Garnish with orange zest and serve immediately.
